#3 Axial Skyrmions  
- This reflection alters the sign of only one pion field, causing the relative phase definition to differ by π compared to refs.[3, 12, 7], where the antiSkyrmion is defined by flipping the sign of all three pion fields.  
- The adopted definition facilitates a more natural comparison with the analogous situation for magnetic monopoles.  
- The profile function vanishes at radius s/2 from the Skyrmion (or antiSkyrmion) centre, enabling a continuous patching of the Skyrmion and antiSkyrmion configurations.  
- Fields are set to the vacuum state outside each core, and initial conditions incorporate both the simple ansatz (3.7) and the more refined rational map ansatz [11] with axial symmetry and baryon charge n.
